fields.label: How It Works
fields.options:
1. Each record of the DocType below can have its own folder in SharePoint, named by Folder Name Pattern. With Folder Creation set to Automatic it is created on the record's first attachment; with On demand, only when someone clicks Create folder now on the record or adds a Microsoft Drive Folder.
  2. Files attached to a record that has a folder (sidebar attachments, not image or Attach fields) are moved into it in the background a few seconds later. They keep opening from the record, through the ERP's own permissions.
  3. Files people save into the folder from Teams or SharePoint show on the record in the Files in Microsoft 365 panel.
  4. Nothing is deleted from SharePoint unless Microsoft Settings says so, and then only to the site recycle bin.

Setting up: paste the site URL (for a Teams channel: Files tab › Open in SharePoint), save, click Site Grant Script and have a SharePoint admin run it, then click Test. Standard channel: keep Group record folders in a base folder on and use the channel name as Base Folder. Private or shared channel: use the channel's own site and untick it, so record folders sit directly in the channel.

fields.description: Attachments on records of this DocType are stored in SharePoint. One mapping per DocType.
fields.label: DocType

fields.description: Automatic: every record gets a folder on its first attachment, and all its attachments move to SharePoint. On demand: nothing moves until someone creates the record's folder (Create folder now on the record, or a new Microsoft Drive Folder); from then on that record's attachments move, and other records stay on this server.
fields.label: Folder Creation

fields.description: The site that owns the library, e.g. https://contoso.sharepoint.com/sites/Sales. For a Microsoft Teams team, open the channel's Files tab and choose Open in SharePoint.
fields.label: SharePoint Site URL

fields.description: The library's display name. Teams channel files live in Documents (shown in SharePoint as Shared Documents).
fields.label: Document Library

fields.description: On: record folders go inside the Base Folder below. For a standard Teams channel keep this on and use the channel name, since that is the channel's folder. Off: each record's folder goes straight into the library. For a private or shared channel, which has a site of its own, that is the channel's Files tab, with no extra folder in between.
fields.label: Group record folders in a base folder

fields.description: Path inside the library, created if missing. For a standard Teams channel this is the channel name, e.g. Projects. Nested paths like Projects/2026 work.
fields.label: Base Folder

fields.description: One folder per record, named from its fields: {name}, {title}, or any {fieldname}, e.g. {name} - {customer}. Characters SharePoint does not allow are replaced.
fields.label: Folder Name Pattern

fields.description: Looked up from the URL on first use. Cleared whenever the URL or library changes.
fields.label: Site ID
